Because both traversals reach Rachel, Rachel is a descendant of Sarah and a descendant of Tyler; therefore Sarah and Tyler share at least one common descendant.  

Inspection of the two descendant sets shows  
- no path from Sarah to Tyler,  
- no path from Tyler to Sarah,  
- no common ancestor for Sarah and Tyler (neither person possesses any incoming ancestor edge).  

Hence only statement 2 holds.
